observed_gap: Core V41 introduces AccountLease.run(..., allow_failover=False) so every deliberate provider step after strict provider-intent publication can fail closed on ambiguous transport without switching accounts.
Agent DynamicReservationLeaseSession's ReservationAwareLease protocol and run/run_selected forwarding surface do not expose or forward allow_failover.

Therefore a unified Core+Agent server that routes a protected post-intent step through DynamicReservationLeaseSession cannot express Core V41's no-failover requirement; the underlying AccountLease default remains allow_failover=True.
On ambiguous transport the current wrapper can therefore switch A->B even though Core's durable intent was published for the selected lease/account boundary.
required_integration_contract: Extend the Agent lease protocol/session forwarding surface with caller-controlled allow_failover, defaulting to true to preserve existing Agent rotation semantics.
Core protected post-intent deliberate planner steps must call DynamicReservationLeaseSession with allow_failover=false and the flag must reach the exact underlying AccountLease.run invocation.

Reservation-driven reselection before provider entry remains allowed where the Core intent has not yet committed to a provider attempt; after strict intent, ambiguous transport must not cause sibling failover or outer recursive retry.
Regression must cover initial protected transport, planner-correction transport, default Agent failover compatibility and exact call-count/switch-count evidence.
limits: No Windows, production, real account data or secrets used.
